latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — scaffold production-grade Kubernetes operator projects in Go or Python, including CRDs, controllers, RBAC, webhooks, and Dockerfiles.

- Generates full project structure for either kubebuilder (Go) or kopf (Python).
- Produces OpenAPI-validated CRDs with status subresources, printer columns, short names, and categories.
- Scaffolds reconciliation controller/handlers with finalizers, status updates, and idempotent patterns.
- Creates least-privilege RBAC, deployment manifests, and CI-ready Dockerfiles.
- Provides prerequisite checks and install commands for required tools before scaffolding.
